text:
Predicates:
HaveTeeth(x) ::: x has teeth.
Mammal(x) ::: x is a mammal.
Platypus(x) ::: x is a platypus.
Human(x) ::: x is a human.
Premises:
∃x (Mammal(x) ∧ HaveTeeth(x)) ::: Some mammals have teeth.
¬∃x (Platypus(x) ∧ HaveTeeth(x)) ::: Platypus have no teeth.
Platypus(x) → Mammal(x) ::: Platypus are mammals.
HaveTeeth(human) ::: Humans have teeth.
Conclusion:
Mammal(human) ::: Humans are mammals.
